mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it reduces the cost of capital and increases equity valuation multiples.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.8%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 4.8, or the average 5-day return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate revenue growth slows.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) fails to predict 20-day SPX returns with a Rank IC above 0.05, or the negative return pattern is not observed in more than 60% of interaction-triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an imminent economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as manufacturing activity weakens.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, INDPRO < 112.0 is not associated with negative 60-day SPX returns (average return > -0.5% or p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A higher CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% annually signals persistent inflation, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the Federal Reserve delays rate cuts and real rates rise.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for CPIAUCSL as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or the correlation between CPIAUCSL and 20-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the level of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) falls below 130,000 (thousands), it signals a weakening labor market that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate hiring.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS < 130.0, or the average 5-day return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as both manufacturing and consumer sectors weaken.
failure_condition: The interaction term (INDPRO * HOUST) fails to predict 20-day SPX returns with a Rank IC above 0.05, or the negative return pattern is not observed in more than 60% of interaction-triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-driven slowdown regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 signals a manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as supply chain disruptions and production cuts hurt corporate profits.
failure_condition: In supply-driven slowdown periods, INDPRO < 110.0 is not associated with negative 60-day SPX returns (average return > -0.5% or p > 0.05).
